author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonny DeLuca (hamstring) could be activated this weekend
desc: Rays manager Kevin Cash said Jonny DeLuca could be activated from the injured list this weekend.
impact: Cash is playing a rehab game for Triple-A Durham on Wednesday. If all goes well, he could be activated at some point this weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vaughn Grissom activated from IL
desc: The Angels activated Vaughn Grissom from the injured list.
impact: Grissom makes his way back from the injured list. Trey Mancini was designated for assignment as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mickey Gasper (groin) back in lineup Wednesday
desc: Mickey Gasper is back in the Red Sox lineup on Wednesday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Gasper returns from a two-game absence. He is batting leadoff in his return.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ben Rice goes deep as Yankees thump White Sox
desc: Ben Rice went 1-for-4 in Tuesday's win over the White Sox with a home run, two walks, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Rice continues a productive stretch at the plate, collecting hits in eight of his last 12 contests. The first baseman remains one of the more explosive bats in a Yankees lineup without Aaron Judge and Giancarlo Stanton, carrying a 1.006 OPS with 20 home runs, 49 RBI, 53 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 66 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cody Bellinger racks up three hits in 12-2 rout
desc: Cody Bellinger went 3-for-4 in a win over the White Sox with two runs scored and two RBI.
impact: Bellinger continues a steady stretch at the plate, registering hits in eight of his last 12 games. The outfielder remains one of the more dynamic options in the Yankees lineup, posting a .833 OPS with 10 home runs, 47 RBI, 43 runs scored, and eight stolen bases through 70 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Paul Goldschmidt goes deep as Yankees crush White Sox
desc: Paul Goldschmidt went 2-for-5 in Tuesday's 12-2 win over the White Sox with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Goldschmidt continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in 10 of his last 16 contests. The veteran continues to offer manager Aaron Boone with another impactful option in a Yankees lineup without Giancarlo Stanton and Aaron Judge, slashing .298 with 10 home runs, 33 RBI, 25 runs scored, and one stolen base across 46 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Caballero homers in win over White Sox
desc: Jose Caballero went 2-for-4 in a si moved the White Sox with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Caballero has heated back up at the plate, recording hits in four of his last five contests. The 29-year-old has been one of the more steely options in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, batting .263 with seven home runs, 23 RBI, 27 runs scored, and 15 stolen bases across 60 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trey Mancini designated for assignment
desc: The Angels are designating Trey Mancini for assignment.
impact: Mancini returned to the majors for the first time since 2023. He will likely clear waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wenceel Perez (face) likely unavailable Wednesday
desc: Wenceel Perez is not expected to be available for Wednesday's game against the Astros.
impact: Perez was struck in the face by a plyo band Tuesday night in the training room. He is day-to-day following the freak accident.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani to manage knee inflammation
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Shohei Ohtani's left knee inflammation is not behind him, but will be managed moving forward.
impact: It likely explains why Ohtani will not be in the lineup while starting on Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ron Marinaccio has suspension reduced to two games
desc: Ron Marinaccio's suspension was reduced to two games.
impact: Marinaccio was initially handed a three-game suspension. He'll miss the next two games, starting on Wednesday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Anthony Volpe chips in three hits as Yankees rout White Sox
desc: Anthony Volpe went 3-for-5 in Tuesday's 12-2 win over the White Sox with one run scored.
impact: Volpe has offered mixed results at the plate of late, picking up hits in four of his last eight contests. The infielder remains one of the more streaky options in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, batting .237 with one home run, 11 RBI, 13 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 23 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Teoscar Hernandez (hamstring) could begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Teoscar Hernández could start a rehab assignment as early as Tuesday.
impact: Hernandez is expected to head on a rehab assignment with Triple-A Oklahoma City. He could be activated by the end of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) unlikely to be activated Friday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Will Smith is not expected to be activated when first eligible on Friday.
impact: Roberts said Smith is progressing and went through a full workout on Tuesday. He could be activated at some point next week.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Spencer Jones homers in win over White Sox
desc: Spencer Jones went 1-for-3 in a win over the White Sox with a home run, two walks, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Jones has provided mixed results at the plate, picking up hits in four of his last eight contests. The outfielder continues to fight consistency issues at the plate for manager Aaron Boone, batting .239 with two homers, seven RBI, four runs scored, and one steal through 18 games.
